ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light gray) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark gray) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity vertical zone extending from the peduncle junction; large contiguous high-intensity white fields on the lateral lobes; dense low-intensity speckling and mottling concentrated along the lower-medial margins and scattered across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; significant depth relative to the vertical axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; notable macro-scale indentations/missing tissue segments on the upper-left trailing edge; continuous fine-grain jaggedness along the posterior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer lateral margins terminating in acute, upward-tapering tips; concave trajectory from the lateral maxima toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, raised circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) densely localized on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) visible against the high-intensity white background on the right and left lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy parasitic/barnacle encrustation on both distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple pinniped silhouettes (sea lions) in the immediate foreground, partially occluding the water-line interface of the fluke.
